summary.momentum_policy: Each original M_ij uses only the smallest momentum label unequal to its endpoints. Other M terms seed no descendants or overlaps. The runtime matcher rejects their occurrences before substitution. Keep the actual-context decreasing-order check.
summary.execution: Classify final prepared rules by maximum-degree unbolded products
summary.potential_LMs: Only maximum degree and unbolded-product terms before unions
summary.candidate_interreduction: All established replacements, independent of groups
summary.initial_overlaps: All minimal unions of eligible LM patterns, through their summed degree
summary.spectator_context_limit: No further extensions of minimal parent overlaps
summary.early_discard: Stop at the first irreducible above-bound term before later factor removal
summary.timing_scope: Fresh construction, interreduction, context preparation and checkpoint I/O; verification separate
summary.queue_order: Current raw/remainder S-polynomial degree; lower degrees first
summary.pair_rechecks: Only pairs involving a new or changed parent presentation
summary.cached_context_rechecks: Insert already known cached routes by exact product divisibility; no matching
summary.above_bound_work: Deferred with exact partial reduction certificate; never silently deleted
summary.overlap_matching: Instantiate only the supplied parent embeddings
summary.route_reference: Smallest largest RHS monomial; then remaining monomial support
summary.checkpoint_format: Atomic complete state; last two generations retained
summary.storage: Exact compressed records in SQLite; mutable values pinned until safe boundary
summary.queue_identifier_storage: Lossless compressed polynomial keys; original hash retained
summary.function_cache_scope: All v3.2 source modules and arithmetic aliases
